regime.label: Egypt - Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing
regime.correction_mechanism: credit note (document type c) referencing the original invoice UUID; debit note (d) for an increase
regime.scope: Taxpayers ETA has notified, in waves since 2020. A taxpayer checks its own obligation in ETA's obligated-taxpayer inquiry. B2C sales go through the separate e-receipt system, which this row does not model.

commencement.scope: Taxpayers named in ETA notification lists, phased from 2020 (ETA Decision 188/2020)
commencement.notes: Legal basis Unified Tax Procedures Law 206/2020, Art. 35. The wave dates come from secondary sources only and are not stated here. The same-day submission deadline widely reported from 2023-01-01 is not enforced by this platform.

regime.notes: Submission is asynchronous: ETA answers 202 with a UUID, then validates; the document stays submitted until a refresh reads valid or invalid. Every document carries a CAdES-BES signature made with an eSeal certificate on a USB token or HSM. An identical request body within 10 minutes is refused as a duplicate. Source: https://sdk.invoicing.eta.gov.eg/ read 2026-10-19.
